text:
Anika Patel: Quick intake — pen test report landed this morning. We need a retest window after fixes. Main open items: RBAC changes, KMS key rotation, and audit log sampling gaps.
Sam K.: Ack. Can we doc the exact RBAC deltas so SRE can stage the role cutover?
Anika Patel: I started a short matrix in the doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/pt-1890 (see table at the top). TL;DR: three service principals need new read-only audit roles + one temporary escalation role for the assessor.
Leo (ops): For the temporary escalation, we prefer timeboxed sessions via short-lived SSO assertions. Can we avoid long-lived IAM changes? :+1:
Maria D: We also need to prove audit exports for the retest window. The report flagged missing CloudTrail entries for a 2hr period. Ops, can you confirm log retention and export pipeline health?
Leo (ops): Checking now. deploy-bot: pipeline-health check started for logs-export-prod.
deploy-bot: logs-export-prod: last successful export 2026-03-18T07:12:21Z, backlog: 0, retention-policy: 90d.
Leo (ops): Looks like the pipeline is healthy but we have a blindspot — the KMS key used for export rotation was in pending rotation state for 1 hour on the day of the gap. That could explain missing ciphertexts.
DevSec-Jen: Important — we need a signed attest that KMS key rotation didn't drop messages. Can we produce key usage audit with key-id + encrypt/decrypt counts for the window?
Anika Patel: Sam, can your team produce the key usage metrics and a remediation plan for key rotation timing? We want to avoid re-running a full export if possible.
Sam K.: Yep. I'll pull KMS CloudAudit and the envelope metadata. Expect a short package by EOD. Also planning RBAC PR with canary plan.
Maria D: For retest scheduling: target next Wed 09:00-11:00 PT for the readroom. That gives teams 48h to ship fixes. Anybody objects?
Leo (ops): Works for oncall schedule. I'll reserve the ops bridge and pre-stage ephemeral roles.
DevSec-Jen: DevSec will run a quick dry-run of the assessor role provisioning on Tue afternoon. Add me to the PR for RBAC so I can gate it.
Anika Patel: Owner assignments: Sam -> KMS usage packet + RBAC PR. Leo -> bridge and log export proof. Maria -> retest scheduling and evidence handoff. Jen -> review and gating. I'll track remediations in the tracker and coordinate the assessor handshake.
Sam K.: One caveat: the RBAC changes require a Terraform module update. I plan to do a canary apply to staging then the timeboxed prod apply using ephemeral creds. Command plan attached:
```
# canary apply
terraform workspace select staging
terraform apply -var-file=canary.tfvars
```
Maria D: Nice, include the plan output in evidence. Assessor needs tamper-proof artefacts (signed plan + state snapshot).
Leo (ops): Also, reminder: export proof should include raw CloudTrail JSON for the window + KMS audit lines. I'll script the extraction and sign with our audit key.
DevSec-Jen: Sounds good. If any of the fixes change the attacker surface (e.g., new roles), we'll need a short regression test set. Add a note in the tracker.
Anika Patel: Noted. I'll add regression prompt tests and alert thresholds.
Sam K.: Packaging ETA: 2026-03-18 18:00 PT. If anything slips, I'll flag immediately here.
Maria D: Thanks. I'll send the assessor the readroom invite and pre-req checklist after Sam's packet lands.
Anika Patel: Awesome — I'll post the final retest checklist and link to the tracker once Sam confirms. :rocket:
Sam K.: Packet uploaded: https://redwood.internal/evidence/pt-1890/kms-and-rbac-package.zip
Leo (ops): Extraction script and signed logs uploaded to the audit bucket with presigned link shared in the tracker.
DevSec-Jen: Reviewed RBAC diff, left one inline comment about least-privilege for the escalation role. Sam, can you tighten the policy to deny write to /prod/configs?
Sam K.: Will update and repush.
Anika Patel: Great teamwork. We'll reconvene Tue 16:00 PT for a final go/no-go. If anyone needs to escalate sooner, ping @anika.
